notes.title: New Map: Village Announcement
notes.content:
[h1][b]New Map: Village Announcement [/b][/h1]

[previewyoutube=znAwc7vKF0Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Dear Cursed Despair Players,[/b]

We are thrilled to announce that we are working on a brand new map update for Cursed Despair! Our team has been diligently working to bring you an immersive and thrilling new environment to explore. This upcoming update will include:

[list]
[*] [b]Village:[/b] Discover the terrifying secrets that await you in an abandoned Village.
[*] [b]Enhanced Gameplay:[/b] Experience improved gameplay mechanics and smoother navigation.
[*] [b]Stunning Visuals:[/b] Enjoy enhanced graphics and detailed environments that bring the game world to life.
[/list]

Stay tuned for more details and the official release date. We are eager for you to dive into the new map and experience all the exciting content we've prepared. Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm for Cursed Despair!

notes.title: Update V0.0.0.2: Fixes and Feedbacks
notes.content:
[h1]Game Balance Improvements and Optimization Improvements[/h1]

We hear your feedbacks and made some changes.

[h3]Game Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Holy Cross spawn count increased and respawn time reduced.
[*]Fastest Monster slightly slowed down.
[*]The final phase of the Monster has been placed slightly forward.
[/list]

[h3]Optimization Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sudden FPS Drops fixed. 
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Some localization errors fixed.
[*]Fixed some visual bugs in the UI
[/list]

notes.title: First Trailer Is Out
notes.content:
Hey Gamers,

Our first trailer is out, and get ready for a terrifying experience!

If you're ready, welcome to this terrifying world we've prepared for you. Surviving in this terrifying world relies on collaboration with your friends. Adding it to your wishlist will ensure you're among the first to dive into this experience when the game launches.
